title: SAR ADC Controller
constraints: The testbench models the analog half: `cmp = (vin >= dac / 256 · VREF)`, updated immediately whenever `dac` changes.
A rising edge sampling `start = 1` while idle begins a conversion. `start` is ignored during a conversion.
Find the 8-bit code by successive approximation (MSB first). When finished, pulse `done` for one cycle with `result = clamp(floor(vin / VREF · 256), 0, 255)`. `result` holds afterwards.
Each conversion must complete within 40 clock cycles (8–10 is typical).
hints: Binary search: trial code = current bits with the next bit set to 1. Put it on `dac`, and at the next edge keep that bit if `cmp = 1`, otherwise clear it.
Start from `8'b1000_0000` and walk a bit pointer from 7 down to 0.
`cmp` depends on `dac`, so present each trial code for a full cycle before sampling `cmp`.

examples.title: busy
examples.input: a second start during a conversion
examples.expected: no effect: the running conversion completes
